title: Add Kotlin RAG pipeline quickstart with tool-binding example
author: Avery Huang
description: This PR introduces a new Kotlin quickstart demonstrating a lightweight RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipeline with explicit tool binding and structured output parsing. Motivation: broaden our quickstarts to JVM ecosystems and provide a reference that shows how to wire Redwood SDK calls from a Kotlin coroutine-based microservice, integrate a local vector store adapter, and attach a simple tool (websearch mock) using the tool-calling pattern. The quickstart contains: a Gradle project (build.gradle.kts) with the minimal Redwood client binding, a Kotlin RAG orchestrator that streams tokens and emits structured JSON blocks, a sample Dockerfile and K8s manifest for local testing, compact integration tests that run against the included in-memory vector store, and a docs site page under /docs/quickstarts/kotlin-rag-toolbinding with step-by-step instructions and common troubleshooting. Key constraints addressed: show coroutine-friendly streaming, demonstrate prefix caching usage in the client, and how to configure deterministic tool fallbacks when the primary external tool is unavailable. The PR also updates the docs sidebar and adds a tiny example screenshot and api-snippet inlined in the docs page. No production runtime code changes outside examples/docs. See commits and files_changed for details.
commits: Initialize Kotlin quickstart scaffold (build files, README)
Implement RAG orchestrator and tool-binding adapter
Add integration tests and CI job
Docs: add quickstart page + screenshots and links

review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice to see a JVM example — please add a short note in the README about supported JDK versions and Gradle wrapper recommended settings.
Avery Huang: Added the JDK note and pinned Gradle wrapper; also included a tiny troubleshooting section for classpath issues.
Priya Nair: Integration test looks good but I had a flake locally when the mock websearch returned a 500 — can we add explicit retry/backoff in the tool adapter?
Avery Huang: Implemented exponential backoff with capped retries in ToolBindings.kt and added a test case for transient 500 errors.
Liam Chen: Docs language is clear; suggest a one-line security note reminding users not to send PII to public vector stores in the example. Added that line as requested.
Priya Nair: CI had one flaky JDK 21 matrix run; reran and it passed. Approving after CI green.
release_notes: Added Kotlin quickstart: an end-to-end RAG pipeline example showing tool-calling and streaming from a coroutine-based microservice. Useful for JVM teams getting started with Redwood.
notes_for_maintainers: This is a docs/examples-only change; keep the quickstart under the quickstarts/ top-level folder. The new CI workflow runs only on docs/examples paths to minimize runtime CI cost. If we later promote this to an official SDK sample, move code into examples/jvm with the same package layout.
user_impact: Low (docs and examples only). Provides new onboarding material for JVM engineers.
